@normanmaurer Our current test case (Invalid XML file, should cause a connection exception and connection close)
- We write a file containing invalid xml to an EmbeddedChannel
- call poll() on the CollectingListener
- check that a connectionError has been thrown
- check that the connection has been closed i.e. channelInactive was called.

issue.title: Correctly run all pending tasks for EmbeddedChannel when the Channel …

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
…was closed.

Motivation:

When a user called ctx.close() and used the EmbeddedChannel we did not correctly run all pending tasks which means channelInactive was never called.

Modifications:

Ensure we run all pending tasks after all operations that may change the Channel
 state and are part of the Channel.Unsafe impl.

Result:

Fixes [#6894].
